points.point: Can Blotato reply to a reply (not just top comments)
points.sentence: Replies to replies are not supported. You can reply to a top-level comment, but not to a reply.
Reply to a top-level comment on your published Instagram and Facebook posts.

verdict.reason: This entry says Blotato can reply to top-level comments on Instagram but not to replies, which answers the question and likely explains the failure.
